name: Forma Spatial
tagline: We build interactive 3D environments in photorealistic detail.
lede: Artworks, places and objects, captured on site: explore them live in your browser, or film them from any angle in 4K.
intro: We capture real places and objects as 3D scenes in photographic detail, so you can walk around them in your browser: artworks shown online the way they stand in the room, important places archived as they are, homes you can tour before you visit, food you can turn on your screen.
